local_review.finding_body: The submitted test configured ClientProxyFactoryBean and inspected its getters but never created a client proxy. The resolved statistics therefore reported 0 of 3 dynamic-access calls covered, violating the requirement for coverage above 20% when dynamic-access calls exist.
local_review.finding_title: Dynamic-access coverage was below the required gate
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the setup-only test with a native-compatible ClientProxyFactoryBean scenario that creates and inspects a real proxy using SourceDataBinding, XML binding, and local transport; changed the CXF transport dependency to use the tested library version, added the required XML binding dependency and test-package filter, and regenerated and split metadata and statistics. Coverage increased to 1 of 3 calls (33.33%).
local_review.review_comment: Approved after repairing the contribution-owned test and metadata. The final tree passes the exact Forge finalization command, including current defaults, future defaults, GraalVM 25, metadata validation, style checks, and regenerated statistics; dynamic-access coverage is now 1/3 (33.33%).
